description: Free-text search over the PTPGE vocabulary and registers — the open specification of print. Returns a ranked list of matching terms with their URI, notation, preferred label, level (top-concept / group / category / sub-category / element), group, and a relevance score (0.0–1.0).

groups.description: Optional filter by group code(s), e.g. ["substrates", "configurations"]. Omit for all groups.

include_deprecated.description: Also return deprecated terms (they still resolve by URI but are no longer vocabulary). Default false: a brand name resolves to its register entry (kind=supplier) instead of the retired term.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code for label and definition matching.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

query.description: Free-text query. Matched against notation, label, altLabels, and definition.

query_language.description: ISO 639-1 code for the language the QUERY is written in — not the language of the labels you want back (that is `language`). Optional, and it never changes the results: search always looks across every language. It is used only so that a phrase we cannot resolve is recorded against the right market, which is how missing synonyms get found and added. Send it if you know it; omit it if you do not.

name: ptpge_search_terms
title: Search the vocabulary
